inlines.v: SCLEROT'IC, a. [Gr. hard; hardness.] Hard; firm; as the sclerotic coat or tunicle of the eye. SCLEROT'IC, n. 1. The firm white outer coat of the eye.2. A medicine which hardens and consolidates the parts to which it is applied.
